page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-30-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance configuration includes 30 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 15 physical cores with multithreading enabled, supported by 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster. Advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AES, and VAES are present to accelerate vector processing and cryptographic operations. System memory comprises 120 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 4 GB per vCPU allocation.

Storage configuration consists of 804 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity across two physical drives. The instance does not feature GPU acceleration and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Synthetic testing demonstrates strong single-core performance, evidenced by a top-quartile stress-ng single-core score of 2,866.18 and competitive text-processing marks in Geekbench. PassMark memory testing registers in the upper 25 percent, while uncached large-block write bandwidth exhibits lower relative throughput at 24.67 GB/sec.

The bundled high-speed local NVMe storage combined with a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio provides a balanced cost-efficiency profile for transactional workloads. Rather than relying entirely on remote network-attached disks, the direct-attached NVMe storage minimizes I/O latency for data-intensive processing. However, the asymmetric uncached write performance requires consideration for heavy disk-to-memory streaming operations.

Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-30-lssd serves general enterprise applications, relational and non-relational database nodes, caching layers such as Redis, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and containerized microservice deployments requiring high local I/O throughput.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-30-lssd is a general-purpose cloud instance equipped with 30 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor and 120 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. Built on x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 vector support, it includes 804 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage distributed across two drives, omitting hardware GPU acceleration. Benchmark profiles indicate strong single-core compute results and top-quartile PassMark memory performance, accompanied by consistent mid-tier throughput across multi-core compilation and database operations. Uncached memory write bandwidth presents a notable performance limitation under sustained high-volume operations. The bundled low-latency local storage makes this instance cost-effective for I/O-intensive workloads, fitting relational databases, distributed caching layers, application backends, and continuous integration environments.
